defs.d: All the things under discussion.
defs.ex: I checked the list again and everything is done.

defs.d: Many or most things.
defs.ex:
A:What do you want to do at the amusement park?
B:Everything!

defs.d: The allowing of possession of a property etc. in exchange for rent.
To allow to, not to prevent (+ infinitive, but usually without to).
defs.ex: After he knocked for hours, I decided to let him come in.

defs.d: To leave.
defs.ex: Let me alone!

defs.d: To hinder, prevent, impede, hamper, cumber; to obstruct (someone or something).
To prevent someone from doing something; also to prevent something from happening.
A group sharing a common understanding, and often the same language, law, manners, and/or tradition.
A residential or religious collective; a commune.
An option allowing a gamer to resume play after game over, when all lives have been lost.
A statement which causes a loop to start executing the next iteration, skipping the statements following it.
To proceed with (doing an activity); to prolong (an activity).
defs.ex: Do you want me to continue to unload these?

defs.d: To make last; to prolong.
A blow; a punch; a striking against; the collision of one body against another; the stroke that touches anything.
defs.ex: The hit was very slight.

defs.d: Something very successful, such as a song, film, or video game, that receives widespread recognition and acclaim.
(heading, physical) To strike.
To manage to touch (a target) in the right place.
defs.ex: I hit the jackpot.

defs.d: Very successful.
defs.ex: The band played their hit song to the delight of the fans.

defs.d: A raised stage from which speeches are made and on which musical and other performances are made.
A raised floor for any purpose, e.g. for workmen during construction, or formerly for military cannon.
To furnish with or shape into a platform
To place on, or as if on, a platform.
To move on skis
To travel over (a slope etc.) on skis; to travel on skis at (a place), (especially as a sport)
A group of sports utilizing skis as primary equipment.
A covered vehicle used for carrying goods or people, usually roughly cuboid in shape, longer and higher than a car but smaller than a truck/lorry.
defs.ex: The van sped down the road.

defs.d: An enclosed railway vehicle for transport of goods.
To transport in a van or similar vehicle (especially of horses).
(used in passive voice) Of law enforcement: to arrest (not necessarily in a van; derived from party van).
A collection of organized things; a whole composed of relationships among its members.
defs.ex: There are eight planets in the solar system.

defs.d: A method or way of organizing or planning.
defs.ex: Followers should have a system to follow that works in their interests, not against them.

defs.d: (manner) In an incredible manner; not to be believed.
(degree) To a great extent; extremely.
defs.ex: He was incredibly wealthy.

defs.d: A tough material produced from the skin of animals, by tanning or similar process, used e.g. for clothing.
A piece of the above used for polishing.
To cover with leather.
To strike forcefully.
defs.ex: He leathered the ball all the way down the street.

defs.d: Made of leather.
Referring to one who wears leather clothing (motorcycle jacket, chaps over 501 jeans, boots), especially as a sign of sadomasochistic homosexuality.
The legal department of a company.

defs.d: Paper in sheets 8½ in × 14 in (215.9 mm × 355.6 mm).
Relating to the law or to lawyers.
defs.ex: legal profession

defs.d: Having its basis in the law.
defs.ex: legal precedent

defs.d: An attendant spirit, often in animal or demon form.
defs.ex: The witch’s familiar was a black cat.

defs.d: A member of one's family or household.
Known to one, or generally known; commonplace.
defs.ex: there’s a familiar face; that tune sounds familiar

defs.d: Acquainted.
defs.ex: I'm quite familiar with this system; she's not familiar with manual gears

defs.d: In a high or esteemed manner.
defs.ex: He spoke highly of you.

defs.d: Extremely; greatly; very much.

defs.d: Related to finances.
defs.ex: For financial reasons, we're not going to be able to continue to fund this program.

defs.d: Having dues and fees paid up to date for a club or society.
defs.ex: Jerry is a financial member of the club.

defs.d: To bend back (light, etc.) from a surface.
defs.ex: A mirror reflects the light that shines on it.

defs.d: To be bent back (light, etc.) from a surface.
defs.ex: The moonlight reflected from the surface of water.

defs.d: In a successful manner; with success; without failing.
defs.ex: He successfully climbed the mountain.

defs.d: An expression granting permission; an indication of agreement with a proposal; an acknowledgement that a person, thing or event meets requirements.
defs.ex: I need to get an approval on this purchase order.

defs.d: An expression of favorable acceptance and encouragement; a compliment that also condones.
defs.ex: Words of approval never seem to come from him.

defs.d: A person who is below the age of majority, consent, criminal responsibility or other adult responsibilities and accountabilities.
defs.ex: It is illegal to sell weapons to minors under the age of eighteen.

defs.d: A subject area of secondary concentration of a student at a college or university, or the student who has chosen such a secondary concentration.
defs.ex: I became an English minor.

defs.d: To choose or have an area of secondary concentration as a student in a college or university.
defs.ex: I had so many credit hours of English, I decided to minor in it.

defs.d: Of little significance or importance.
defs.ex: The physical appearance of a candidate is a minor factor in recruitment.

defs.d: Of a scale which has lowered scale degrees three, six, and seven relative to major, but with the sixth and seventh not always lowered
defs.ex: a minor scale

defs.d: Of or relating to the drama.
Striking in appearance or effect.
An attack.

defs.d: The posture of attacking or being able to attack.

defs.d: Causing offense; arousing a visceral reaction of disgust, anger, or hatred.
defs.ex: An offensive smell.

defs.d: Relating to an offense or attack, as opposed to defensive.
defs.ex: The army's offensive capabilities. An offensive weapon.

defs.d: The act of conveying or removing something from one place, person or thing to another.
An instance of conveying or removing from one place, person or thing to another; a transferal.
To move or pass from one place, person or thing to another.

defs.d: To convey the impression of (something) from one surface to another.
defs.ex: to transfer drawings or engravings to a lithographic stone

defs.d: Something of value given in return for an act.
defs.ex: For catching the thief, you'll get a nice reward.

defs.d: A prize promised for a certain deed or catch
defs.ex: The rewards for bringing in badly wanted criminals are printed on 'dead or alive' posters

defs.d: The act of preparing or getting ready.
The state of being prepared; readiness.
